meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把静态设计变成动感短片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做短视频或社媒素材，想让画面更有动感
copy.tagline_en: Turn static designs into eye-catching motion shorts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make short videos or social media content and want more dynamic visuals.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会制作短运动图形（约10秒、无旁白），自动完成规划、素材、设计、构建与检查，并在渲染前征得你同意后输出 MP4 或透明叠加文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作短的设计导向运动图形时触发，如动态文字、数字滚动、图表动画等；更长、带旁白或多场景的任务不会触发。

say.text: 做一个5秒的数字滚动动画，显示销售额从1万涨到100万。
say.note: 会走 stat 类别，产出 MP4。

say.text: 把这张图变成动态图表，让柱状图逐根升起。
say.note: 会按图表类别生成运动图形。

say.text: 这个logo要做出场动画，渲染成透明背景视频。
say.note: 会走 logo-reveal 类别，输出透明叠加。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude produces a short, unnarrated motion graphic (≈10s), automatically planning, sourcing, designing, building and verifying, then asking for your approval before rendering to MP4 or a transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short, design-led motion graphic such as kinetic text, number count-up, or chart animation; longer, narrated, or multi-scene requests are not handled here.

say_en.text: Make a 5-second count-up animation showing sales going from 10k to 1M.
say_en.note: Uses the stat category and renders MP4.

say_en.text: Turn this image into an animated chart with bars rising one by one.
Create a logo sting and render it as a transparent-background video.
say_en.note: Uses logo-reveal and outputs an overlay.
